description: This is a unit test class written in PHP, using the PHPUnit framework, for testing the BeanFactory component of SuiteCRM. It contains test methods to verify bean creation, retrieval, metadata, class names, object names, file paths, and file loading functionalities related to beans in the system.

classes.name: BeanFactoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the BeanFactory in SuiteCRM, verifying bean creation, retrieval, metadata, class, name, object, file path, and loading functionalities.

methods.name: testNewBean
methods.description: Tests the creation of new beans and verifies their class instances after extension.

methods.name: testGetBean
methods.description: Tests retrieving beans and verifies their class instances before and after module extension.

methods.name: testGetBeanMeta
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of bean metadata such as class name, object name, and class file, both before and after extension.

methods.name: testGetBeanClass
methods.description: Checks that the class returned for a bean matches expected class names, pre- and post-extension.

methods.name: testGetBeanName
methods.description: Ensures that the bean name matches the class name and correctly differs after extension.

methods.name: subTestGetCustomBeanName
methods.description: Sub-test to verify the custom bean name obtained matches the expected value.

methods.name: testGetObjectName
methods.description: Validates that the object name retrieved matches expected values, before and after extension.

methods.name: subTestGetCustomObjectName
methods.description: Sub-test to verify the custom object name obtained matches the expected value.

methods.name: testGetBeanFile
methods.description: Checks that the bean file path matches expected class file paths, before and after extension.

methods.name: subTestGetCustomBeanFile
methods.description: Sub-test to verify the custom bean file path.

methods.name: testLoadBeanFile
methods.description: Tests loading bean files and confirms that the classes are loaded and exist after loading.
